svg.text: DIP switch bank L12, as it sits on the board
Switch 8 is on the left. ON = slider pushed toward the printed numbers. Shown: 6, 7, 8 OFF.
In MAME, switches 6 and 7 appear as "Language", and 8 as the minimum-credits option.
The same switches on the self-test screen
Second row of digits. Here switch 1 is on the LEFT, the opposite of the board, and 1 means OFF.
Example: 00000111 = switches 6, 7 and 8 OFF (Tubes 1–16 then classic, demo player can die); 1–5 ON.
Auxiliary (Math Box) board, switch bank D/E2
Numbers along the top, ON = slider pushed toward them. Shown: Atari's suggested settings.
OFF = dimmed text and logo (Atari's suggested)
Third row of digits. Only the last three are switches, and here 1 means ON (the opposite of L12).
Example: 00000011 = Atari's suggested settings: switch 2 OFF (dimming on), 3 and 4 ON (Medium).
